theorem_cxcix: Every key parameter of the perfect classical codes [7,4,3] and [23,12,7] and the fundamental quantum codes [[5,1,3]] and [[7,1,3]] is an integer expression in the W(3,3) atoms: n(Hamming)=PHI6, d(Hamming)=Q, k(Golay)=K, d(Golay)=PHI6, n(5-qubit)=EIG_MAX, d(5-qubit)=Q, n(Steane)=PHI6, d(Steane)=Q, n(RM)=PHI4+EIG_MAX, k(RM)=PHI6, with zero free parameters.
